name: Refresh
desc: +1 use of Refresh offers per run.

name: Skip
desc: +1 use of Skip upgrade per run (gives you PokéDollars).

name: Banish
desc: +1 use of Banish: removes one option for the rest of the run.

name: Revive
desc: You start with a Max Revive.

name: Archive
desc: +5 Archive slots per level. Also, every 2 items you unlock give you 1 more slot. Archived items won't show up in Poké Balls or the shop.

name: Harmony
desc: The Ultimate charges 4% faster per level.

name: Big Bag
desc: You can take 3 items from the Bag into each run (instead of 2).
